quotes.quote: Eligible Denial of Service (DoS) findings are capped at the **Medium** severity bounty rate for the affected asset.
Third-party assets outside HackerOne's control are not authorized for testing because HackerOne cannot grant permission to test infrastructure it does not host or operate.
Issues affecting assets under HackerOne's control are in scope.
Include the header you used in your vulnerability report so HackerOne can identify your activity and deconflict it from other testing.
All vulnerability reports and related data must be treated as sensitive and handled accordingly.
Reports affecting third-party assets will generally be closed as **Informative**.
In exceptional cases, HackerOne may award a discretionary bonus when a report demonstrates meaningful value to HackerOne's security posture.
Failure to comply with these testing requirements may result in your submission being deemed ineligible for a bounty.

Reports that include prohibited testing methods or actions are **not eligible** for a reward.
